sheet.title: P&IDS PRE-AERATION BASIN
sheet.issue_status: DESIGN/BUILD DOCUMENTS - prepared for submission to EPA in July 2021 to provide a general understanding of the project concept; not intended to reflect design requirements
legend_notes: Horizontal bands: SCADA HMI / REMOTE I/O CABINET 2 / MCC. Bubble position gives its location. Nothing is drawn in the MCC band on this sheet.
Diamond-in-square symbols marked AI are untagged remote I/O points; they are not recorded as instruments, each is noted on the signal that passes through it.
The process air line from flag A to the diffuser FBD-050111 is drawn dashed; the other process lines are thin solid.
Hexagon TP 01 with 'BO | EQ' and opposing arrows sits on a pipe joint symbol on the process air line (tie point / scope break as drawn; no legend on this sheet).
Sheet 11 of 25. CAD filename P-200 P&IDS.DWG. No revisions entered in revision table. No line numbers or pipe sizes are printed.

equipment.name: FBD (diffuser symbol on basin floor, fed by process air)
equipment.notes: Only the tag FBD-050111 is printed; no descriptive text.

components.name: TP 01 tie point (BO | EQ) at pipe joint
components.notes: Hexagon 'TP 01' over a pair of joint bars on the process air line; 'BO' with arrow on the upstream side, 'EQ' with arrow on the downstream side. Meaning of BO/EQ not defined on this sheet.

components.name: WE-050121 (weir/overflow symbol on basin end wall at water level)
components.notes: Rectangle with diagonal, lower half filled, on top of the right-hand basin wall where the overflow line leaves.
Symbol: filled diamond between two end bars; valve type not identified (no legend on this sheet). Number 120122 recorded as drawn. Nothing is drawn beyond this valve.

instruments.notes: Bubble drawn touching TIT-050102 (combined DO/TEMP transmitter above probe AE-050102). No separate line is drawn from AE-050102 to this bubble; measures set to the basin the shared probe sits in.

lines.notes: Drawn dashed from flag A, through the TP 01 joint, then down into the basin to the diffuser. No arrowhead; direction from the flag text 'FROM BLOWERS'.

Pipe through the right-hand basin wall near the floor, running right and up to valve V-120122; nothing is drawn or labelled beyond the valve.
